answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 7162 Country: India Title: Is there any differencnce between ISAA & MEHDI (A.S).I hav came across a hadith that (LAISAA ILAMEHDI) means ISAA is no one but MEHDI is it true Question: Is there any differencnce between ISAA & MEHDI (A.S).I hav came across a hadith that (LAISAA ILAMEHDI) means ISAA is no one but MEHDI is it true Answer ID: 7162 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1038/921=L/1429) Hadhrat Eisa and Hadhrat Mahdi are two different personalities, they are not same. Where did you see the abovementioned Hadith, quote the reference, then we shall reply you in-sha-Allah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
